patterns.note: Asymmetrical two-column layouts for project showcases, with large, often full-bleed, visuals dominating one side and concise text on the other.
Distinctive use of a wide, uppercase serif font for primary branding and section titles, contrasted with clean, smaller sans-serif for body text and even smaller uppercase labels.
A high-contrast dark mode palette (black/dark grey backgrounds, light text) punctuated by vibrant, project-specific accent colors that are contained within the visual elements.

A multi-stage scroll-triggered sequence where the initial 3D hero element scrolls out to reveal content sections, and then a transformed, monochrome version of the hero element scrolls into view as a concluding brand mark, accompanied by a change in navigation and footer content.
Each project section is visually distinct in its content and accent colors but follows a consistent structural pattern of a title/description block paired with a large, engaging visual.

technique_notes: Uses a scroll-triggered animation system (likely css-keyframes, as hinted) to orchestrate a complex sequence: the initial 3D hero scrolls out, content sections fade/slide in sequentially, and then a final brand mark (a transformed, monochrome version of the hero) slides in with a new set of navigation links and footer content.
Employs high-fidelity 3D rendered objects as central visual elements, particularly for the hero and concluding brand mark, giving a tactile and premium feel.
Utilizes a sticky element on the side that appears after initial scroll, providing a persistent brand or status indicator.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, wide, uppercase display serif (~4-5x body) for branding and section titles, paired with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and very small, often uppercase, mono-spaced labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners dominate, with some subtle rounding on interactive elements or 3D objects.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy and spacious, particularly in hero and between major content blocks, creating a sense of premium presentation; content within project sections can be more compact.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a transforming 3D hero element that acts as both an initial brand statement and a concluding, simplified brand mark, creating a memorable and interactive scroll experience that ties the beginning and end of the page together.
